comment: Registry of real opportunities Guardian discovers and analyzes. Pool ids reference real DefiLlama yields pools; contract addresses are real mainnet addresses; standing/minimumRecommendedUsd/risks are Guardian's documented editorial rubric (product guidance), never fabricated market data.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Staking (Lido)
opportunities.exitConditions: Unstaking runs through Lido's withdrawal queue; same protocol, lower priority.

risks.title: Smart-contract risk
risks.description: Staking contracts could contain vulnerabilities, although Lido is a battle-tested canonical protocol.

risks.title: Market risk
risks.description: ETH price fluctuates independently of staking rewards.

risks.title: Withdrawal conditions
risks.description: Unstaking can face a withdrawal queue during high demand.

risks.title: Reward changes
risks.description: Staking APR varies with total network participation.

opportunities.name: Stablecoin Lending (Aave V3 USDC)
opportunities.exitConditions: Withdraw anytime at current pool utilization, subject to available liquidity.

risks.title: Smart-contract risk
risks.description: Lending protocols carry smart-contract risk; Aave is a major audited protocol.

risks.title: De-peg risk
risks.description: USDC could lose its peg in extreme market conditions.

risks.title: Utilization risk
risks.description: High utilization can temporarily limit withdrawals.

opportunities.name: Liquidity Provision (Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC)
opportunities.expectedInteraction: Provide a USDC/WETH position (0.3% fee tier)
opportunities.exitConditions: Remove liquidity anytime once the position range is within the current price; fees accrue while within range.

risks.title: Impermanent loss
risks.description: Price divergence between the paired assets can reduce position value.

risks.title: Smart-contract risk
risks.description: DEX contracts, while audited, can still contain vulnerabilities.

risks.title: Market volatility
risks.description: Sharp price moves can amplify impermanent loss.
